intro: The key to Dino World is building a balanced roster instead of only upgrading one dinosaur. Play a few battles, watch which unit survives longest, then spend upgrades where the squad is weakest.
guideIntro: Treat each battle as a test of your lineup. Frontline dinosaurs should survive long enough for damage units to work, while upgrades should remove the biggest failure point first.
steps: Start by unlocking a small squad before over-investing in a single dinosaur.
Upgrade health on frontline dinosaurs if battles end before your damage units can attack.
Upgrade damage when fights time out or enemies survive with low health.
Replay early battles to understand which enemies punish weak positioning.
Spend new rewards immediately on core stats before chasing optional collection goals.
